target: Rediseño visual autorizado de fauna natural no combatiente de los Llanos de Edran; romper por completo la lectura dinosauriana antes de integrar a runtime.
art_direction: REDISEÑO VISUAL AUTORIZADO. Mantener la locomoción 4+2 y la adaptación al viento, pero abandonar la silueta previa. El Velozanco debe parecer un animal original de llanura construido alrededor de un cuerpo central bajo, ancho y suspendido, parecido en masa a una semilla o cápsula orgánica aplanada, no a un torso vertebrado con pecho, cuello y caderas. Seis apoyos nacen alrededor de la masa corporal: cuatro patas locomotoras largas y delgadas distribuidas en dos pares equilibrados y dos apoyos anteriores más cortos. Cabeza pequeña, roma y baja, parcialmente encajada bajo el borde frontal del cuerpo, sin cuello visible. Sin cola corporal reconocible: sólo dos cortos filamentos rígidos sensoriales emergen juntos del borde posterior. Sobre el lomo existe una banda membranosa blanda, baja y plegada por el viento, nunca una vela. Fauna ambiental, tímida y veloz. Paleta fría/neutra de Edran. CORRECCIÓN OBLIGATORIA TRAS v004: los dos apoyos anteriores cortos deben ser patas rígidas visibles que TERMINAN EN EL SUELO, con puntos de contacto inequívocos y pequeñas sombras de contacto; no pueden colgar del vientre. Los dos filamentos posteriores deben ser diminutos muñones sensoriales rígidos pegados al borde posterior, nunca prolongaciones tipo cola.
prompt: Create one original alien-but-natural plains animal for Vintage Telnet, shown completely in a low three-quarter side view in the Llanos de Edran. DESIGN FROM A NEW SILHOUETTE; do not imitate the previous reference image. Start from a broad, low, flattened seed-pod-shaped CENTRAL BODY suspended above the ground. The body must read as one continuous oval/capsule mass with NO chest, NO pelvis emphasis, NO upright torso and NO visible neck. Arrange exactly SIX weight-bearing supports around this central mass: four very long, slender locomotor legs in two balanced pairs, with the front and rear pair similar in visual importance, plus two noticeably shorter auxiliary supports near the lower front quarter. All six are legs/supports, never arms. The tiny blunt head is tucked low into the underside/front rim of the central body, almost like a sensory prow: broad and rounded, no muzzle, no beak, no reptile skull, no neck. At the rear there is NO conventional fleshy tail. Instead, exactly TWO short rigid sensory filaments project directly from the rear edge of the body, each much shorter than a leg. Across the upper body lies a LOW SOFT DORSAL MEMBRANE like a flexible strip of skin pressed flat sideways by the crosswind; it is not triangular and does not rise above the body as a sail. Give the animal smooth matte hide with subtle longitudinal folds, no scales and no armor. Pose it moving laterally with all six supports clearly understandable and the body staying level, like a wind-adapted ground runner rather than a predator. Natural cautious non-combat behavior. Background subordinate: muted green-gray field margins, blue-gray overcast sky, brown-gray soil and only sparse pale straw. Cool neutral daylight. The finished silhouette should be recognizable even as a black shape: low central capsule, four balanced stilts, two short front supports, tiny tucked-under head, and two tiny rear filaments. CRITICAL GEOMETRY FOR NEXT ATTEMPT: show BOTH short anterior auxiliary legs fully from their attachment points to the ground. EACH of the two short front supports MUST visibly TOUCH the ground with a small foot/contact tip and a contact shadow; place them slightly separated left/right so neither is hidden by perspective or by a long leg. They are short rigid load-bearing legs, NOT dangling appendages. CRITICAL REAR: the TWO posterior sensory filaments must be TINY STUBS only, no more than roughly one-tenth of a long leg length, projecting only a very short distance from the rear body rim. They must NOT create any tail silhouette.
negative_constraints: ABSOLUTELY NO dinosaur, theropod, raptor, ornithopod, bird, lizard or reptile silhouette
No conventional vertebrate body plan with distinct chest, long neck, pelvis-heavy rear or counterbalancing tail
No visible neck; head must be tiny, blunt and tucked into the lower front edge of the body
No snout, muzzle, beak, reptilian skull, teeth or predatory face
No conventional tail; only exactly two short rigid rear sensory filaments emerging directly from the body edge
No bipedal impression and no oversized rear legs; front and rear long leg pairs must carry equal visual weight
Exactly six weight-bearing supports: four long locomotor legs plus two short anterior supports
No insect exoskeleton, segmented abdomen, antennae or arthropod head
No feathers, wings, dorsal sail, rigid fin, spikes, horns or armor
No dominant ochre, amber, yellow or golden palette; pale straw may appear only as a minor background accent
No attack pose, glow, magic, readable text or HUD
No hanging front appendages: both short anterior supports must visibly reach and contact the ground
No hidden/occluded short supports: both must be separately readable with ground contact and contact shadow
Rear filaments must be tiny stubs, approximately <=10% of a long leg length; never tail-length

notes: ABANDONADA 2026-10-01: Tras 7+ intentos de generación con gpt-image-2.5-flare, la anatomía de 6 patas no-dinosaurio sigue sin generarse correctamente. El modelo falla consistentemente en: (1) anatomía de cápsula + 6 patas balanceadas, (2) posición de cabeza tucked-under, (3) filamentos posteriores diminutos. La complejidad geométrica excede las capacidades del modelo. Revisar estrategia: puede ser necesario un prompt radicalmente diferente, un modelo diferente, o esperar mejoras futuras.
